# Peptide Source Hub — Factory-Direct Wholesale Peptides
> https://peptidesourcehub.net
> China-based peptide manufacturer since 2009. 50+ research peptides & HGH kits in bulk; identity data sourced from public databases and published per product.

## Core Pages
- [Homepage](https://peptidesourcehub.net/): Wholesale peptides, 6 categories, specs, FAQ
- [About](https://peptidesourcehub.net/about/): Factory story, team, QC workflow, stats
- [Contact](https://peptidesourcehub.net/contact/): WhatsApp, Telegram, email, factory address
- [Products](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/): 50+ peptides across 6 categories, with a machine-readable specification dataset
- [FAQ](https://peptidesourcehub.net/faq/): 14 questions — ordering, quality, shipping, OEM

## Product Categories
- [Cosmetic & Skin](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/cosmetic-skin/): GHK-Cu, Snap-8, Leuphasyl, Argireline, Matrixyl
- [Healing & Recovery](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/healing-recovery/): BPC-157, TB-500, Thymosin Beta-4, ARA-290
- [Metabolic Research](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/metabolic/): Semaglutide, Tirzepatide, Cagrilintide, Retatrutide, AOD-9604
- [Muscle Growth](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/muscle-growth/): CJC-1295, Ipamorelin, GHRP-2, GHRP-6, PEG-MGF
- [Nootropic & Anti-Aging](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/nootropic-anti-aging/): Semax, Selank, Epithalon, DSIP, FOXO4-DRI
- [Specialty Stacks](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/specialty-stacks/): Pre-formulated multi-peptide research kits

## Featured Products
- [BPC-157](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/bpc-157/): Gastric pentadecapeptide, CAS 137525-51-0, ~1419.5 Da, healing & tissue repair
- [TB-500](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/tb-500/): Thymosin Beta-4 fragment, CAS 77591-33-4, cell migration research
- [Semaglutide](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/semaglutide/): GLP-1 receptor agonist, CAS 910463-68-2, ~4113.6 Da, metabolic research
- [Tirzepatide](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/tirzepatide/): Dual GIP/GLP-1 agonist, CAS 2023788-19-2, ~4813.5 Da
- [Cagrilintide](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/cagrilintide/): Long-acting amylin analogue, CAS 1415456-99-3 (NCBI PubChem CID 171397054), dual-pathway metabolic
- [Retatrutide](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/retatrutide/): Triple GIP/GLP-1/GCGR agonist, CAS 2381089-83-2, next-gen metabolic
- [GHK-Cu](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/ghk-cu/): Copper tripeptide-1, CAS 49557-75-7, collagen synthesis & skin research
- [HGH](https://peptidesourcehub.net/products/hgh/): Human Growth Hormone, CAS 12629-01-5, ~22125 Da, GH/IGF-1 axis research
